body.title: Forgejo v18.0.0
body.description:
## Release notes - Breaking security features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14148): Move internal communication to UNIX socket. The `INTERNAL_TOKEN` can now be dropped from the configuration, and the UNIX socket path can be configured using the `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PATH` options. This change removes the `./forgejo generate secret INTERNAL_TOKEN` command and updates the contrib Forgejo systemd unit file. The `forgejo.service` example systemd file has been updated to set `RuntimeDirectory=forgejo`, which is a recommended setting for all systemd users.
See the [documentation](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/#server-server) for more information. - User Interface features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14038): adds inline copy buttons for new repo instructions - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14299): add reload protection to file dropzone and code review comments - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14425): allow users to preview fonts in the ui - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14536): make dropdowns dialog-based with various improvements - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14158): accessible aria-labels & working commit description toggles w/o JS - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14522): disable text wrapping in code blocks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13517): auth: start oauth2 login if its the only available login - User Interface bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14435): Fix icons in milestone and project metadata not being consistent with how icons are used elsewhere on Forgejo - Features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14386): feat(lfs): add lfs file support to /render endpoint - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14571): enh: add org members to other teams without invitation - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14117): team membership provenance tracking - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13023): add code suggestion - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14505): feat(feed): parse and set limit parameter for release feed request - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14164): feat(cmd): allow password to be read from stdin - User Interface changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14598): sort user repositories in package linking, make input searchable - Other changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14703): use DB index when accessing API `GET /{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?head_sha=...` - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14621): deleting a user w/ repo-specific access tokens or authorized integrations causes foreign-key violation - Included for completeness but not user-facing (chores, etc.) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14508): refactor: migrate relative-time component to Typescript - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14633): fix(CLI): settings not loaded for create-authorized-integration - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14713): chore: keep locale instructions out of readme, only link to relevant resources - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14666): refactor: migrate svg component to Typescript - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14689): Actions logs are not transferred to object storage when last UpdateLog has no rows - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/10065): uses lang attribute to set the right language for tippy tooltip - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14564): refactor: migrate JS configs to Typescript - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14664): refactor: migrate utils component to Typescript - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14538): refactor: migrate emoji component to Typescript - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14692): chore: fix forgejo branch - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14628): prevent in-db branch state rollback from concurrent pushes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14269): Use the minus (−) sign instead of hyphen (-) for better alignment with the plus (+) sign - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14685): chore: fix release notes for PR 14148 - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14688): Update dependency katex to v0.18.10 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14687): Update dependency @lezer/highlight to v1.2.5 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14642): unblock concurrency group job if previous run finished by server-side evaluation - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14680): output error message when internal socket can't be created - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14665): Update dependency @codemirror/lang-liquid to v6.3.3 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14652): enh: enable maintainer edits by default on new repositories - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14667): fix(tests): fix flaky TestConvertInvitedUserWithExpiry - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/12757): fix descriptions generated from struct comments - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13971): feat(api): endpoints to manipulate team invites - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14583): share the head branch check + improve suggestion error - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14606): Update dependency htmx.org to v2.0.11 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14629): accept Arch Linux packages with non-zero epoch - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14535): Fix LFS raw file test, add additional cases - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14553): prevent off by one by excluding `size == 1024` in `BlobsLessThan1024...` - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14540): improve error message in case of token not found - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14457): Update golang packages to v1.27 (forgejo) - autoclosed - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14406): chore: setting/security better testing, refactoring, add onlySymmetric() and onlyHS256() key config constraints - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14562): test: fix intermittent test failure in `TestAPIAuthWithAuthorizedIntegration` - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14561): Update CodeMirror (forgejo) - autoclosed - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14183): fix(ui): make font size of repo watchers count consistent with stars and forks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14155): Update module github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint to v2.14.0 (forgejo) - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14543): chore(release): v17 is cut - run renovate on v17 branch - Already announced in the release notes of an older stable release - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14704): remove resync_all_hooks task from admin UI - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14644): fix(auth/basic): return incorrect credential error on non existent email - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14523): show error message when non-existent user is being added to org - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14647): reduce memory usage during Actions log & artifacts uploads -
